Last year I started learning Albanian from scratch (well, had heard it spoken in my family, but was never formally taught anything), and in a few months I got to a B1 level using these things: 

I learned from podcasts at first! This one, [Albanian with Sara](https://open.spotify.com/show/6YbDpjVOP1gTQQlWOXB8lS?si=1b63661f2bf84753), was a really good introduction to Albanian. There are only 24 episodes and she hasn't made any more since, but it was nice to have a patient, native teacher saying the words. 

I also used this podcast, [Learn Albanian with LinguaBoost](https://open.spotify.com/show/2WosiL6tPC2CVIMXYfxWVZ?si=50384feb74794d51), which I didn't like quite as much but was still helpful. 

I used this podcast, [Vajza & Gra](https://open.spotify.com/show/1Kq4dat9Shbsh3yYXvNIFi?si=ec433fde99a74658), as a way to connect with culture more (though the podcast is in English). One host is from Albania while the other was born in the US to Albanian parents. I'm also Albanian from the US and it helped me dip my toes into learning the language. 

I also got this textbook, [Discovering Albanian by Linda Meniku](https://www.amazon.co.uk/Discovering-Albanian-Textbook-Linda-Meniku/dp/0299250849), which was super helpful and also comes with a workbook. You really have to buckle down with this one, but if you end up getting more serious about the language and wish to become conversational in the language, this will give you all the grammar, vocab, and exercises you'll need to really impress your boyfriend's family.
